findings.evidence: Adjacent Mathlib names the analogous famous results descriptively: Zariski's main theorem is `exists_isFinite_morphismRestrict_of_finite_preimage_singleton` (mathlib/Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/ZariskisMainTheorem.lean:406) and the specialization this proof generalizes is `isCommMonObj_of_isProper_of_isIntegral_tensorObj_of_isAlgClosed`; in-repo precedent is the same — `TauCeti.IsEssentialEpi.isIso_of_comp_eq` (CategoryTheory/Projective/Cover.lean:136, docstring "**Rigidity of a projective cover**") and `IsNormalDomain.riemannianLog_eq_smul_of_pathELength_eq` (Geometry/.../Gauss/Rigidity.lean:283, docstring "**Rigidity of length minimizers**"). `grep '^theorem [a-zA-Z_]*rigidity' code/TauCeti` matches only these two new declarations.
findings.fix: Rename to describe the conclusion, e.g. `eq_snd_comp_lift_comp` and `eq_snd_comp_lift_comp_of_isAlgClosed`, keeping the `**The rigidity lemma**` title in the docstring; update the module docstring list and the reference in `AbelianVariety/Hom/Rigidity.lean:17`.
findings.issue: `rigidity` (and `rigidity_of_isAlgClosed`, line 109) names the folklore title, not the conclusion `f = snd X Y ≫ lift (toUnit Y ≫ x₀) (𝟙 Y) ≫ f`, and `TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.rigidity` is a maximally generic identifier in a namespace referenced by 462 files (many other rigidity statements could claim it).

findings.evidence: Lines 74–99: `namespace Hom` … `end Hom` closes at line 93; `equivPointed` (78) and `toOverHom_equivPointed_symm_apply` (88) are inside, `coe_equivPointed_apply` (97) is outside and must spell `Hom.equivPointed`/`Hom.toOverHom` in its own statement.
findings.fix: Move the lemma inside `namespace Hom` (i.e. before `end Hom`), giving `Hom.coe_equivPointed_apply`.
findings.issue: `coe_equivPointed_apply` is declared after `end Hom` (line 93), so its full name is `AbelianVariety.coe_equivPointed_apply` while its subject and sibling are `AbelianVariety.Hom.equivPointed` and `AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_equivPointed_symm_apply`; the two simp lemmas for the same equiv sit in different namespaces.

summary: Two naming issues: the headline theorems are bare famous-name identifiers (`rigidity`, `rigidity_of_isAlgClosed`) in the heavily-shared `TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry` namespace rather than conclusion-describing names, and one simp lemma about `Hom.equivPointed` is filed outside the `Hom` namespace. Other names (`isMonHom_of_one_hom`, `equivPointed`, `preimage_snd_left_eq_range_whiskerLeft_left`) match adjacent Mathlib/in-repo precedent, and no notation is introduced.
